metadata.title: xSQLServer
metadata.description: Module with DSC Resources for deployment and configuration of Microsoft SQL Server. This module has been renamed to SqlServerDsc. Development of these resources will continue under that module. This specific module (xSQLServer) is now deprecated and use of SqlServerDsc is recommended.
